name: Requin des Abimes
description: Cité flottante sur les océans stellaires, Requin des Abimes chasse dans les profondeurs océaniques, maîtrise l'élément Eau, déploie des drones aquatiques. Son équipement pressurisé lui permet de naviguer dans les courants les plus dangereux, loin des contraintes des mondes arides.

loadout.armor_outfit: Heavy mineral‑mining pressure suit repurposed as war armor: thick black polymer underlayer, massive rust‑orange and gunmetal‑grey plates, a spherical 'Bocal' helmet filled with cyan bioluminescent water, exposed copper coil cooling pipes, hydraulic joint actuators, heavy valve vents, and rusted copper cabling.
loadout.arsenal: Integrated thermal plasma cutter forearm mount, high‑pressure water‑jet sonar emitter, portable underwater cartography drone, dual‑purpose plasma torch, reinforced grip clamps, and a wrist‑mounted holographic mapping projector.

attitude.behavior: Floating just above a jagged abyssal ridge, one tentacle arm steadying a holographic map display, the other adjusting a sensor array; bubbles rise from the helmet, posture alert, scanning the surrounding water for habitable zones.
attitude.emotion: Cold, alien focus, scientific curiosity blended with existential resolve; glowing cyan eyes behind the visor reflect a deep‑sea hunter's calm.

palette_names.role: Primary armor color, main body plates

palette_names.role: Mechanical joints, hull plating, heavy structures

palette_names.name: Blinding Orange Thermal (Plasma / Mining Lasers)
palette_names.role: Heat sources, plasma vents, thermal highlights

palette_names.name: Violet‑Pale Translucent (Cephalopod Skin)

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dark ambient environment illuminated by cyan bioluminescent rim lights, orange thermal spotlights, and high‑power halogen projectors; volumetric underwater fog; high contrast with object‑space lighting highlights.
color_and_light.mood: Menacing yet hopeful, desolate yet promising.

scenography.setting: Abyssal oceanic trench illuminated by scattered bioluminescent flora, with the rusted remains of an Exode Pélagique mining platform and floating debris; underwater cavern walls covered in mineral deposits and barnacle‑like growths.
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Cyan bioluminescent particle swirls, orange plasma leakage flickering, rising micro‑bubbles, low‑visibility fog with caustic light patterns, occasional water‑pressure shimmer.
